lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. The first column contains four distinct spots, followed by a second column of three prominent spots, and subsequent columns becoming less defined toward the posterior frame edge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular blob columns, creating a visible rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp intensity gradient with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries, running parallel to the shark's main axis.
